metadata.title: Swap Two Variables
metadata.description: Swap the values of two variables using a temporary variable.

instructions.main: You are given two variables: 'a' (set to 5) and 'b' (set to 10). Swap their values so that 'a' becomes 10 and 'b' becomes 5. You'll need a third variable to help!
steps: Look at the starter blocks — 'a' is 5 and 'b' is 10
Create a temporary variable to hold one of the values
Use 'set' blocks to rearrange the values
After your code runs, 'a' should be 10 and 'b' should be 5
Click 'Run Code' to check your solution

hints.message: To swap two values without losing one, you need a third variable. Try creating a variable called 'temp'.
The order matters! First, save 'a' into 'temp'. Then set 'a' to the value of 'b'. Finally, set 'b' to the value of 'temp'.
Step by step: temp = a (temp is 5), a = b (a is now 10), b = temp (b is now 5). You need exactly 3 'set' blocks in this order.

test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Variable 'a' should be 10 after the swap.
Variable 'b' should be 5 after the swap.
You need at least 5 'set variable' blocks: 2 for the initial values + 3 for the swap.
